test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

They are virtually unimpeachable in the (unbiased), invariably correct reading of a race.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Prejudiced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unbiased **means not affected or influenced by someone's beliefs or opinions. (निष्पक्ष)

 
 
• **For example- ***I need some unbiased advice.*
 
 
 
• **Prejudiced **means having a preconceived opinion that is not based on reason or actual experience. (पूर्वधारणा)
 
 
• For example- *They are prejudiced against people they don’t know.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about how the reading of a race is always correct and unbiased.
 
• Therefore, the opposite of unbiased is prejudiced.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
• **Captivity: **The state of being kept in a place that you cannot escape from. (कै़द, बंदी-स्थिति)
 
• **Stranger**: A person that you do not know. (अपरिचित व्‍यक्ति)
 
• **Ceasing**: To bring or come to an end. (समाप्‍त होना या करना)
